correctness.rationale: Exact recursion for label depths and depth-independent leaf survival yields both pgfs. Poisson-binomial unimodality gives the exact TV half-mode identity. Leaf-count martingale recursion yields exact variance n/12, size-bias transfer supplies uniform 1/(2 sqrt(3n)) error, and a Fourier local CLT establishes sharp constant. Rational enumeration for all recursive trees n=2,...,8 corroborates exact identities; no finite experiment is used for the infinite-n proof.

value.rationale: Root-depth differences between typical vertices and typical leaves in uniform recursive trees are naturally motivated by external-vs-total path-length work. The exact half-mode identity plus sharp asymptotic TV quantifies distinguishability of leaf versus vertex sampling beyond the already known constant gap of means; it also rigorously separates two non-equivalent leaf sampling mechanisms.
